title: LCLS直線加速器同調光源
summary: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Clock correction without optical delay correction.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜磁彎曲尺度：機制與界面

steps.objective: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」。畫出「電子束 → 光源與光學 → 樣品定位 → 偵測器 → 逐發正規化」並圈出與「磁彎曲尺度」有關的介面。將 momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field) 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：垂直均勻磁場中的曲率半徑由動量除以電荷與磁場決定。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs. Draw Electron beam → Source and optics → Sample position → Detector → Shot normalization and mark the interfaces relevant to Magnetic bending scale. Place every variable of momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field) on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Curvature radius in a uniform transverse field is momentum divided by charge and field. Identify what it cannot establish: Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.
steps.observation: 對照「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜磁彎曲尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Magnetic bending scale: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」的「磁彎曲尺度」採以下合成教學值：momentum=0.3 GeV/c；charge=1 elementary-charge units；field=1 T。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field)；獨立基準為 1.00069229 m。把 momentum 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 1.10076151 m。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, use synthetic inputs for Magnetic bending scale: momentum=0.3 GeV/c；charge=1 elementary-charge units；field=1 T. Check dimensions before evaluating momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field); the independent benchmark is 1.00069229 m. Increase momentum by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 1.10076151 m. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: momentum增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.100069229 m。忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.100069229 m. Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.
steps.check: 原值重算與 1.00069229 m 相符；10%案例與 1.10076151 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 1.00069229 m at baseline and 1.10076151 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（m）？
quiz.explanation: 按 momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field) 逐項代入，結果為 1.00069229；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into momentum/(0.299792458*charge*field) gives 1.00069229; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜磁彎曲尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Magnetic bending scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」設計「磁彎曲尺度」的獨立驗證：比較兩個已知數位動量的半徑，並檢查電荷符號只改彎曲方向。 逐發或逐曝光記錄入射光、樣品位置和偵測器訊號，分開源穩定與樣品穩定。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, independently verify Magnetic bending scale: Compare radii for two digital momenta and verify charge sign changes bending direction. Record incident flux, sample position and detector signal per shot/exposure, separating source and sample stability. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Clock correction without optical delay correction rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「忽略聚焦、邊緣場及束團自場；不是實機磁體設定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Excludes focusing, fringe fields and collective effects; not a machine magnet setting.

只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。

Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」。以本單元「磁彎曲尺度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「比較兩個已知數位動量的半徑，並檢查電荷符號只改彎曲方向。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」的「繞射角尺度」採以下合成教學值：wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 1.22*wavelength/aperture；獨立基準為 6.1e-06 rad。把 wavelength 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 6.71e-06 rad。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, use synthetic inputs for Diffraction angular scale: wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m. Check dimensions before evaluating 1.22*wavelength/aperture; the independent benchmark is 6.1e-06 rad. Increase wavelength by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 6.71e-06 rad. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: wavelength增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 6.1e-07 rad。不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 6.1e-07 rad. This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 原值重算與 6.1e-06 rad 相符；10%案例與 6.71e-06 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 6.1e-06 rad at baseline and 6.71e-06 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（rad）？
quiz.explanation: 按 1.22*wavelength/aperture 逐項代入，結果為 6.1e-06；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 1.22*wavelength/aperture gives 6.1e-06; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 理想圓孔的第一暗環角尺度約為1.22倍波長除口徑。
knowledge.textEn: For an ideal circular aperture, the first dark-ring angle is about 1.22 wavelength divided by aperture.

steps.title: 單元2｜繞射角尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Diffraction angular scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」設計「繞射角尺度」的獨立驗證：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。 逐發或逐曝光記錄入射光、樣品位置和偵測器訊號，分開源穩定與樣品穩定。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs, independently verify Diffraction angular scale: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening. Record incident flux, sample position and detector signal per shot/exposure, separating source and sample stability. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Clock correction without optical delay correction rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。
optionsEn: Retain only a PASS label.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

steps.title: 單元2｜繞射角尺度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Diffraction angular scale: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」。以本單元「繞射角尺度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Clock correction without optical delay correction. For Diffraction angular scale, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲」不是單靠 6.1e-06 rad 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 6.1e-06 rad alone cannot exclude Clock correction without optical delay correction; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 只校正探測器時鐘未校正光路延遲；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Clock correction without optical delay correction; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「自由電子雷射的電子束與光脈衝同步」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Electron-beam and photon-pulse synchronization in FELs and retaining failed cases.
